workflow.critical: Execute ALL steps in exact order — do NOT skip steps
PRE-FLIGHT IS MANDATORY: Run the full spec review checklist and fix ALL blockers BEFORE executing any test. Never run tests on a broken spec file.

PER-TEST LOOP RULE: Process tests ONE AT A TIME. When a test fails you enter the FAILURE PROTOCOL (F1→F2→F3→F4→F5→F6). You CANNOT advance to the next test until ALL SIX steps are complete. NEVER skip any step. NEVER batch failures. NEVER move on without a bug report AND a retest.

step.goal: Pre-flight spec review — find and fix all issues before any test runs
step.critical: This step runs ONCE before the first test. Purpose: catch and fix problems that would cause false failures. A test failure caused by a broken spec is waste — fix the spec first.
step.action: Run deterministic pre-flight check: Command: node {project-root}/AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/core/orchestrator.mjs run-tests --mode review --suite "{suite_name}" Read the JSON output — it reports [BLOCKER], [WARN], and [FIXED] items.
Read: {output_folder}/{story_id}/e2e/tests/{suite_name}.spec.js (complete file)
Read: all .page.js files in {output_folder}/{story_id}/e2e/pages/
Read: {output_folder}/{story_id}/test-data/{suite_name}-valid.json

quality-checklist.check: Every import/require path resolves to a file that actually exists on disk
Page object class names match what is export-default-ed in the .page.js file
Test data is imported or loaded correctly (right path, right variable name)
No circular imports
testData.baseUrl (or equivalent) matches the configured base URL in project.config.json
Every key accessed in the spec (testData.adminUser.email, testData.validInputs.name, etc.) exists in the test data JSON
User credentials come from testData or config.yaml test_users — NOT hardcoded strings
URL paths in testData (loginPath, dashboardPath, etc.) are correct for this project
No REPLACE_WITH_REAL_PASSWORD placeholder values — replace with real values from config.yaml test_users or ask the user
Every async Playwright call (page.click, page.fill, page.goto, locator.fill, etc.) is preceded by await
page.locator() is used instead of deprecated page.$() / page.$$()
page.waitForURL() or waitForLoadState() is used instead of page.waitForNavigation()
No page.waitForTimeout() for waits — use page.waitForSelector(), locator.waitFor(), or expect(locator).toBeVisible() instead
expect() assertions use @playwright/test expect, not Jest or Chai
Locators use stable selectors: getByRole, getByLabel, getByTestId, getByText, or locator('[data-testid="..."]') — not fragile nth-child or XPath unless unavoidable
No test.only() or describe.only() in the file
No unexplained test.skip()
Each test has a unique, descriptive name
beforeEach / afterEach hooks do not leave browser state dirty
Login steps appear in beforeEach, not duplicated in every test body
Tests are independent — no test depends on state left by a previous test
Every method called on a page object in the spec actually exists in the page object class
Page object constructor receives page from Playwright fixtures correctly
All locators in page objects are defined before use
navigate()/goto() methods use this.page.goto(baseURL + path) — not hardcoded full URLs
Tests requiring login use credentials from testData or config.yaml test_users — not hardcoded
Every role mentioned in the user story has at least one test covering its permissions
Negative tests (wrong password, unauthorised role) use clearly invalid credentials

review.fix-if-needed: For every failed check, apply the minimal fix and state what changed: IM-1 → correct the path; match exact filename and casing IM-2 → update class name in import or in the page object IM-3 → fix import path; verify key names match the JSON schema TD-2 → add missing keys to the JSON; remove references to non-existent keys TD-3 → replace hardcoded credentials with testData references TD-5 → replace placeholder passwords with real values from config.yaml test_users PW-1 → add missing await before each async call PW-2/PW-3 → replace deprecated API calls PW-4 → replace arbitrary waits with proper Playwright waiters TS-1 → remove .only modifiers TS-6 → add proper beforeEach setup PO-1 → add missing method to the page object class AU-1 → fix credential references After all fixes, re-run the deterministic check to confirm blockers are resolved. Do NOT run tests while any BLOCKER remains.

step.goal: Per-test execution loop with inline fix protocol
step.critical: LOOP RULE: Process tests ONE AT A TIME. When a test FAILS you enter the FAILURE PROTOCOL (F1→F2→F3→F4→F5→F6). You CANNOT advance to the next test until ALL SIX FAILURE PROTOCOL STEPS are complete. NEVER skip any step. NEVER batch failures. NEVER move on without a bug report AND a retest.
step.action:
FOR EACH {test_name} IN {test_list}:
═══ STEP A — Run the single test ═══ Command: node {project-root}/AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/core/orchestrator.mjs run-tests --suite "{suite_name}" --mode single --testName "{test_name}" Capture: exit code (0 = pass, non-zero = fail)
═══ STEP B — If PASS (exit code 0) ═══ - Increment {pass_count} by 1 - Mark {test_name} as ✅ Passed in test-checklist.md - Append to {execution_log}: "✅ PASS — {test_name}" → Advance to next test
═══ STEP C — If FAIL (exit code ≠ 0) — FAILURE PROTOCOL ═══
⛔ HARD STOP. Complete F1 through F6 IN ORDER before touching the next test.
── F1: DIAGNOSE ────────────────────────────────────────── 1. Read the full error message + stack trace from console or reports/junit.xml 2. Read the spec file lines around the failing assertion or action 3. Read every Page Object file referenced in the stack trace 4. Classify as: TEST BUG — wrong selector / assertion / URL / missing await / bad setup → fix the spec or page object SOURCE BUG — application behaves incorrectly (missing element, wrong API, broken nav) → fix the application source ✋ F1 GATE: error message identified, failing line known, failure type classified.
── F2: FIX ─────────────────────────────────────────────── 1. Open the file that contains the root cause 2. Apply the MINIMAL change that fixes the root cause — one targeted edit 3. Do NOT refactor, rename, or touch anything unrelated to this failure 4. Save the file to disk ✋ F2 GATE: the fix is saved on disk. Confirm before proceeding.
── F3: CREATE BUG REPORT ───────────────────────────────── Create file: {output_folder}/{story_id}/bug-reports/BUG-{next_bug_id:04d}.md Required sections (ALL must be present): • Bug ID, test name, error type (خطأ في ملف الاختبار / خطأ في الكود المصدري) • الملف المُعدَّل: path of the file edited in F2 • مستوى الخطورة: timeout/crash=حرجة | assertion/404=عالية | UI=متوسطة • وصف الخطأ: full error message (verbatim, not summarised) • تشخيص السبب الجذري: specific root cause (NEVER "unknown error") • الإصلاح المُطبَّق: description + before/after code snippet • سجل التتبع: full stack trace in <details> block Then increment {next_bug_id} by 1. ✋ F3 GATE: BUG-{XXXX}.md exists on disk with all required sections. Confirm before proceeding.
── F4: RETEST ──────────────────────────────────────────── Run the same test again to verify the fix from F2: Command: node {project-root}/AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/core/orchestrator.mjs run-tests --suite "{suite_name}" --mode single --testName "{test_name}" Capture exit code. ✋ F4 GATE: retest has run and exit code is captured. Do not proceed without it.
── F5: APPEND RETEST OUTCOME ───────────────────────────── Open BUG-{XXXX}.md created in F3 and APPEND one of these sections:
If F4 exit code = 0 (FIXED): ## ✅ تم الإصلاح — اجتاز الاختبار بعد الإصلاح > تم التحقق بنجاح في: {current_timestamp}
If F4 exit code ≠ 0 (STILL FAILING): ## ❌ لا يزال فاشلاً — يحتاج مراجعة > تمت إعادة الاختبار في: {current_timestamp} — لا يزال يفشل. > ما تمت محاولته: {description_of_fix_from_F2}
✋ F5 GATE: retest outcome section is appended inside BUG-{XXXX}.md. Confirm before proceeding.
── F6: UPDATE CHECKLIST AND LOG ────────────────────────── If F4 passed: - Mark {test_name} as ✅ Passed in test-checklist.md - Increment {fixed_inline_count} by 1 - Append to {execution_log}: "🔧 FIXED — {test_name} | BUG-{next_bug_id - 1} | {fix_type}" If F4 still failed: - Mark {test_name} as ❌ Failed in test-checklist.md - Increment {still_open_count} by 1 - Append to {execution_log}: "❌ OPEN — {test_name} | BUG-{next_bug_id - 1}" - Do NOT retry — one fix attempt only
✅ FAILURE PROTOCOL COMPLETE. All six steps done. Advance to next test.
END FOR EACH
Create or update {output_folder}/{story_id}/bug-reports/INDEX.md with a table of every bug recorded this session (Bug ID | Test | نوع الخطأ | الخطورة | الحالة)

Run the full suite once to produce the canonical JUnit XML: Command: node {project-root}/AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/core/orchestrator.mjs run-tests --suite "{suite_name}" This captures the final state (all fixes applied) in junit.xml
Update the header table in test-checklist.md with final counts: Passed, Fixed-Inline (count as Passed), Still Failing, and overall status

artifact-checklist.file: Final JUnit XML — reflects all fixes applied
Updated with ✅/❌ for every test that ran
Bug reports — one per failure encountered during the loop

quality-checklist.check: Every test in {test_list} was actually executed — no test silently skipped
Every failed test has a corresponding BUG-XXXX.md in bug-reports/ — ZERO undocumented failures
Every bug report has a specific root cause — NOT "unknown error" or "test failed"
Every bug report contains the fix that was applied (before/after code snippet)
Every bug report has a retest outcome appended (✅ Fixed OR ❌ Still Open) — the section must be present even if the fix failed
test-checklist.md reflects final state — fixed tests show ✅, unfixed show ❌, no test still shows ⏳ Pending
Final JUnit XML exists and is non-empty
Number of BUG-XXXX.md files equals the number of tests that failed at any point — count must match

review.fix-if-needed: P5-1 → re-run any missing tests individually using --mode single P5-2/P5-8 → for every failed test without a bug report: create BUG-XXXX.md now (re-read JUnit XML for error details) P5-3 → re-read the stack trace for each report with vague root cause and rewrite it specifically P5-4 → add the before/after code fix to any report missing it P5-5 → for every bug report missing the retest outcome: run the test again now and append the result P5-6 → update any checklist entry still showing ⏳ Pending based on the JUnit XML results P5-7 → re-run the final full suite to regenerate JUnit XML
